"topology": "5T-OTA preamp + CS gain stage + CMOS inverter (3 low-gain stages, non-inverting overall)",
"rationale": "A single high-gain preamp has tau = C*A/gm, too slow for 10 mV overdrive. Three short-L stages of gain ~4-5 each give total gain ~150 with small per-stage tau. Polarity: OTA (+) x CS (-) x inverter (-) = non-inverting. Budget assumes iref = 5 uA: tail 6 uA + CS 3 uA + iref = 14 uA, about 25 uW. The inverter draws only transient current into CL, so it adds no static power."}

```python
VDD = 1.8
L_BIAS = 0.5   # reference / tail mirror length [um]

PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in":   (14.0, 8.0, 22.0),      # nfet input-pair & CS gm/Id [S/A]
    "L_in":      (0.25, 0.15, 0.5),      # input pair length [um]
    "gmid_ld":   (12.0, 8.0, 16.0),      # pfet load / CS-load gm/Id
    "L_ld":      (0.25, 0.15, 0.5),      # load & CS length [um]
    "gmid_bias": (10.0, 6.0, 16.0),      # reference + tail mirror gm/Id
    "K_tail":    (1.2, 0.8, 2.0),        # tail current = K_tail * iref
    "k_cs":      (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # CS-stage current = k_cs * (tail/2)
    "gmid_inv":  (8.0, 5.0, 12.0),       # inverter gm/Id (drive strength)
    "L_inv":     (0.15, 0.15, 0.5),      # inverter length [um]
    "I_inv":     (60e-6, 25e-6, 120e-6), # inverter transient drive current (not static)
    "r_p":       (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # pfet/nfet inverter current ratio
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    iref = spec.get("iref", 5e-6)        # testbench reference current into ibias
    cl = spec["cl"]
    vod = spec["vod"]

    # ---- current budget (static): iref + tail + CS load
    I_tail = p["K_tail"] * iref
    I1 = I_tail / 2.0                    # per-side diff-pair / load current
    I_cs = p["k_cs"] * I1                # stage-2 CS current
    I_inv = p["I_inv"]

    # ---- sizing from design intent (equal gm/Id & L => mirrors track)
    ref  = lut.size("n", p["gmid_bias"], L_BIAS, iref, vds=0.6)
    tail = lut.size("n", p["gmid_bias"], L_BIAS, I_tail, vds=0.3)
    m1   = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], I1, vds=0.4)    # vinp (diode side)
    m2   = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], I1, vds=0.4)    # vinn -> vo1
    m3   = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], I1, vds=0.5)    # diode load
    m4   = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], I1, vds=0.5)    # mirror load -> vo1
    m5   = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_ld"], I_cs, vds=0.5)  # CS stage, gate = vo1
    m6   = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], I_cs, vds=0.5)  # CS load, gate = d1
    m7   = lut.size("n", p["gmid_inv"], p["L_inv"], I_inv, vds=0.9)
    m8   = lut.size("p", p["gmid_inv"], p["L_inv"], p["r_p"] * I_inv, vds=0.9)

    # ---- netlist
    # Polarity: vinp on M1 (diode side) gives vo1 rising with vinp (non-inverting).
    # CS stage inverts (vo2), CMOS inverter inverts again -> vout HIGH when vinp > vinn.
    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("Mref",  "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", ref)
    n.dev("Mtail", "tail",  "ibias", "vss", "vss", tail)
    n.dev("M1",    "d1",    "vinp",  "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2",    "vo1",   "vinn",  "tail", "vss", m2)
    n.dev("M3",    "d1",    "d1",    "vdd", "vdd", m3)   # diode load
    n.dev("M4",    "vo1",   "d1",    "vdd", "vdd", m4)   # mirror load
    n.dev("M5",    "vo2",   "vo1",   "vss", "vss", m5)   # CS amplifier
    n.dev("M6",    "vo2",   "d1",    "vdd", "vdd", m6)   # CS load (mirror of M3)
    n.dev("M7",    "vout",  "vo2",   "vss", "vss", m7)   # output inverter
    n.dev("M8",    "vout",  "vo2",   "vdd", "vdd", m8)

    # ---- first-order predictions
    gds1 = m2.gds + m4.gds                      # vo1 output conductance
    A1 = m1.gm / gds1
    tau1 = (m2.cdd + m4.cdd + m5.cgg) / gds1

    gds2 = m5.gds + m6.gds                      # vo2 output conductance
    A2 = m5.gm / gds2
    tau2 = (m5.cdd + m6.cdd + m7.cgg + m8.cgg) / gds2

    A3 = (m7.gm + m8.gm) / (m7.gds + m8.gds)    # inverter small-signal gain

    # Stage slewing to mid-rail with cumulative gain; output slew into CL.
    t1 = tau1 * math.log(max((VDD / 2) / (vod * A1), 1.0))
    t2 = tau2 * math.log(max((VDD / 2) / (vod * A1 * A2), 1.0))
    t3 = cl * (VDD / 2) / I_inv
    tpd_ns = (t1 + t2 + t3) * 1e9

    # Static power: reference + tail + CS load (inverter has no static current)
    P_uW = VDD * (iref + I_tail + I_cs) * 1e6

    return n, {
        "tpd": tpd_ns,
        "power": P_uW,
        "polarity_ok": 1,
        "voh_rel": 0.99,     # zero-load pull-up of M8 reaches ~VDD
        "vol_rel": 0.01,     # zero-load pull-down of M7 reaches ~vss
        "gain_db": db(A1 * A2 * A3),
    }
```
